task: Bump Go builder image digest and all Go pin sites from 1.27.3 to 1.27.4 to remediate stdlib vulnerability CVE-2026-97054 detected during CI Image Scan.

events.summary: Docker Hub registry manifest/config for the golang image (golang:1.27.4-alpine@sha256:0a5f7fe796599ff487605987432e7619ae45beeb2fba4c2ce0b907879932aebf), verified to contain Go 1.27.4.

Scoped strictly to bumping the Go builder image digest in Dockerfile and updating the Go pin site comment in .github/workflows/ci.yaml, plus this trace. No changes to Go logic (internal/**, cmd/**), Helm chart, RBAC, workflows logic, or documentation.

On 2026-11-11 the CI Image Scan job on PR #244 (a scripts/e2e-only change) failed with Trivy exit code 1, and the code-scanning alert for that ref is CVE-2026-97054 in package stdlib of the nfs-quota-agent binary; main's Dockerfile builder digest contained Go 1.27.3 and go.dev listed go1.27.4 as current.

Pin the builder to a digest verified to contain Go 1.27.4 (golang:1.27.4-alpine@sha256:0a5f7fe796599ff487605987432e7619ae45beeb2fba4c2ce0b907879932aebf) and update all Go pin sites (see git show HEAD --stat: Dockerfile and .github/workflows/ci.yaml).
Changed workflow YAML parses and no 1.27.3 pin remains in .github, Dockerfile, CONTRIBUTING.md. The image build and the Trivy scan result are verified by the PR's CI, pending.
events.scope: Local static verification of changed workflow YAML (.github/workflows/ci.yaml) syntax and repository-wide Go pin sites (.github, Dockerfile, CONTRIBUTING.md). Image build and Trivy vulnerability scan are verified by PR CI, pending.

events.summary: Go builder image digest bumped to 1.27.4 and all pin sites updated; local static validation passed (clean YAML parse and no remaining 1.27.3 pins); image build and Trivy scan verified by PR CI, pending.
Go builder image digest and pin sites bumped to Go 1.27.4 to resolve CVE-2026-97054; local static checks passed; PR CI image build and scan pending.
